tasks.quote: - 🔬 **35 experiments in five disciplines.** Mechanics, circuits, optics, thermal physics and chemistry, built on 19 apparatus platforms (14 for the determination experiments, 5 for the optimization experiments). 30 are determination experiments, which ask for a quantity the goal names (18 basic, 12 advanced); 5 are optimization experiments, which ask for the best result the apparatus allows.

verifier.full_credit: task_completed = G and e <= 1: all declared gates pass (result within the instrument tolerance, result grounded in readings recorded during the episode, bench left in the state the task requires) and the normalized error is at or under threshold
verifier.quote:
Gates run first (all declared gates, in spec order; valid_submission is always
assessed first because the other gates read submission fields), then scoring:
    e_rel = primary relative error (max over targets for max_rel_error; none for composite scores)
    e     = e_rel / threshold, or for composite scores the largest error / its own threshold
    reward = G * max(0, 1 - e);  task_completed = G and e <= 1 (G includes the tidy-up gates the card asks for)

oracle.path: sealed episode + instance store (<store>/<instance_id>.json); offline scorer benchmark/evaluation/evaluate.py
oracle.quote: Offline evaluation service (layer 6): sealed episode + submission + truth -> evaluation.json.

services: environment daemon embodiedlab-envd on 127.0.0.1:8765 (lab container entrypoint)
SAM3 segmentation (host process, one CUDA GPU)
cuRobo motion planning (host process, one CUDA GPU)
exceptions: T2 (the diagnostic level that adds a library of manipulation skills) is not part of this release

the filter optimum search fixes its floating-point path (single-threaded BLAS, one fixed kernel, no AVX-512) and needs an x86-64 machine with AVX2 and FMA3; it takes about half an hour on 48 cores to prewarm
optimization optima may be prewarmed with python -m benchmark.evaluation.truss prewarm <instance.json> (also absorber and filter)
